ranked.headline: Models infer regulatory networks from single-cell and spatial transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Integrating scRNA-seq with spatial and chromatin data now enables inference of regulatory and signaling networks across tissue contexts.

ranked.headline: Mutational, regulatory and structural features link genomic instability to cancer
ranked.summary: Single-cell, CRISPR and regulatory profiling now resolve how instability, repair and regulatory variation shape tumor genomes.

ranked.headline: Null-model bias and molecular QTL mapping sharpen causal inference in complex traits
ranked.summary: Large cohorts and multi-omic atlases now enable genetic mapping of expression noise, isoforms, and metabolites alongside biases in GWAS null statistics.

ranked.headline: Aligning unpaired omics modalities with optimal transport and contrastive learning
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply optimal transport and graph geometry to align spatial and single-cell modalities that lack paired measurements or shared features.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict molecular interactions from learned representations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair graph, transformer, and image-based encoders with task-specific heads for interaction and binding prediction.

ranked.headline: Network topology and sequence graphs are becoming objects of inference in genomics
ranked.summary: Graph-based representations now serve as analyzed or inferred structures across bacterial transfer, pangenomes, metagenomes, and viral phylogenetics.

ranked.headline: Structural and diversity metrics reveal animal genome evolution across lineages
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level and whole-genome datasets across diverse animals now enable structural and diversity-based comparisons of genome evolution.

ranked.headline: Preprocessing and benchmarking workflows for spatial, single-cell, and proteomic data
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks informatics workflows and releases open pipelines for spatial, single-cell, and proteomic measurement data.

ranked.headline: Penalized and goal-directed models stratify omics data for vaccine and sepsis outcomes
ranked.summary: Multi-omics data from vaccine and sepsis studies are now modelled against explicit outcome objectives rather than generic classifiers.

ranked.headline: New computational methods refine gene regulatory and transcript-level analyses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications address isoform-aware regulatory inference, gene specificity scoring, and spike-in ChIP-seq normalization.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking sequencing and informatics tools against reference data across platforms
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks nanopore, TCR-seq and primer-design tools against reference data, extending evaluation to predicting XNA nanopore ionic currents.

ranked.headline: Isoform-resolved long-read data refine splicing, NMD rules and haplotype proteomes
ranked.summary: Transcript-level resolution now shapes splicing regulator analysis, NMD escape rules and haplotype-aware proteogenomics in recent work.

ranked.headline: Language models now drive protein, mRNA, and codon sequence design and prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers standardize embedding access and benchmark general and specialized language models across design tasks.

ranked.headline: Calibrating and detecting variant effects and copy numbers from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Residue-level calibration of effect predictors and clinical annotation layers are now being coupled to read-based variant and copy number calling.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic and deep learning models infer missing or latent omics measurements
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply imputation, generative and probabilistic models to sparse single-cell, methylation, proteomic and long-read data.

ranked.headline: Tools refine genome assembly assessment, metagenomic abundance, and amplicon taxonomy
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce evaluation-driven tools for assembly quality, GC bias, host-read removal, and amplicon classification.

ranked.headline: Models link somatic mutation, plasticity, and spatial aging to disease dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply mathematical and network simulation to mechanistic patterns in breast cancer incidence, cell-state plasticity, and tissue aging.

ranked.headline: Experimental restraints and coarse-grained models resolve protein conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent items extend NMR-restrained and refined force-field simulations to mixed folded-disordered constructs, oligomers, and PTM-modified condensates.

ranked.headline: Sampling frames define inference scope in wastewater, serology and vaccine trial data
ranked.summary: Pooled wastewater sequencing, paired serology and trial immune data now feed directly into tools tailored to each sampling frame.

ranked.headline: Language models and optimization steer RNA sequence design toward structure and binding
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair sequence language models with optimization or conditioning to control generated RNA folds and multi-target binding partners.

ranked.headline: Compressed indexes and sketches speed k-mer and sequence similarity search at scale
ranked.summary: Recent work applies compressed indexes and sketches to million-genome k-mer and similarity search, with pipelines described as laptop-ready.

ranked.headline: Structure-based computational design of peptide, enzyme, and antibody variants
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply structure-based computational design to peptides, enzymes, antibodies, and small-molecule hit-to-lead.

ranked.headline: Brain connectivity beyond pairwise links: higher-order and manifold representations
ranked.summary: Higher-order synergy, network control, and foundation-model manifolds are being used to move beyond pairwise brain graphs.

ranked.headline: Pretrained embeddings fused with structural or graph features for binding prediction
ranked.summary: Recent 2025 preprints and papers pair pretrained protein and molecular embeddings with a second representation for binding and property prediction.

ranked.headline: Stochastic cell models link molecular noise and division control to population behavior
ranked.summary: Explicit modeling of single-cell stochasticity is now used to infer regulation parameters and trajectories from single-cell and gene expression data.

ranked.headline: Motif-level models interpret cis-regulatory syntax and predict miRNA-mRNA interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study pair interpretable motif-level architectures with regulatory element and microRNA target prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Phase-plane and agent-based models frame disease onset as cell-level state transitions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints model protein aggregation and glial bioelectric changes as cell-level state transitions linked to disease onset.

ranked.headline: Topological and network-embedding methods map Alzheimer's disease molecular structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply Mapper topology and node2vec network embeddings to Alzheimer's and disease omics data.

ranked.headline: Diffeomorphic and velocity-field registration map whole-brain data onto mouse atlases
ranked.summary: Recent work aligns MERFISH, fMOST, MRI and LSFM mouse brain data to shared atlases, enabling quantitative readouts in atlas coordinates.

ranked.headline: Automated pipelines chain reproducible steps toward drug and biomarker endpoints
ranked.summary: Recent tools connect omics processing, docking, and natural-language interfaces into single executable analysis chains.

ranked.headline: Learned models address missing and heterogeneous omics data across platforms and tissues
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply masked autoencoders, negative binomial models and foundation models to incomplete, sparse omics and histology data.

ranked.headline: Thermodynamic and kinetic constraints tightening metabolic models against measured data
ranked.summary: Recent tools automate thermodynamic-stoichiometric model construction and fit kinetic models to time-course data, enabling tighter model validation.

ranked.headline: ML and enhanced sampling accelerate structure-based fragment and virtual screening
ranked.summary: Expensive sampling, docking, and quantum-chemical steps in fragment and screening workflows motivate machine learning and enhanced-sampling shortcuts.

ranked.headline: Pattern-based tools map DNA methylation motifs and Z-DNA forming sequences genome-wide
ranked.summary: Nanopore basecaller modification data and genome-scale pattern searches now enable computational mapping of methylation and non-B DNA motifs.

ranked.headline: Formal algorithms for non-tree genomic structures in pangenome and phylogenetic networks
ranked.summary: Pangenome and phylogenetic network data demand scalable, provably correct methods beyond tree-based models.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based inference links smORFs, disordered regions and novel enzymes to function
ranked.summary: Structure prediction, protein language models and disorder benchmarks now expose protein features missed by conventional annotation.

ranked.headline: Convergent antibody binding modes and near-universal SARS-CoV-2 immune escape
ranked.summary: Large structural and database-scale resources now allow systematic comparison of antibody-antigen binding and viral escape.

ranked.headline: Lipids, ions and electrostatics tune transporter conformational energetics
ranked.summary: Recent atomic-level MD and cryo-EM studies attribute transporter transition energetics to specific lipid, ion and electrostatic contacts.

ranked.headline: LLM agents turn literature, structures and notebooks into biological hypotheses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply agentic LLM workflows to enzyme design, gene set curation, and single-cell annotation beyond static protein language models.

ranked.headline: Computational separation of protein information from pooled or confounding proteomic data
ranked.summary: Pooled and multiplexed proteomic and imaging workflows generate complex data that computational deconvolution must resolve to recover protein-level information.
